body.description: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean outline, detailed shading. One item only, it fills most of the square, transparent background. Each item stays fully inside its own square and does not touch the edges. No pedestal, no stand, no display base, no plate, no text, no letters, no numbers, no extra objects.
item_descriptions: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean dark outline around the whole object, detailed shading. an eye-only half mask, front view, wide and flat: the top edge sweeps outward into two pointed tips at the far left and right, the bottom edge cuts up into a deep V notch at the center where the nose goes, two narrow almond-shaped eye holes slanting slightly upward, smooth hard lacquered shell, sleek and elegant. Not an animal head: absolutely no ears, no horns, no fur, no snout, no beak sticking out, the outline stays a smooth mask shape. The animal is only hinted at by a stylized shape of the edge and a faint engraved pattern. Plain glossy deep navy-black surface, single color, engraving in slightly lighter dark grey. Raccoon hint, shown by the outline shape and not by patterns: two small rounded peaks on the top corners, the eye holes sit inside a wide bandit band that flares out past the cheeks. It stays a half mask covering only the eyes and upper nose, never the muzzle, mouth or jaw. Only this item, nothing else beside it, no text, no halo or glow outside the object's outline, fully inside its square.
